heading: Liji 15 · Shao Yi 少儀 · Smaller Rules Of Demeanour · Shao Yi 22 … Shao Yi 44

items.text: When seated as personatrix of your husband's deceased grandmother, do not bow with your head to your hands; make only the curtsy.
items.quote: When seated as a personatrix (of the deceased grandmother of her husband), she did not bow with her head to her hands, but made the curtsy.
items.conflict: Personating the dead conflicts with the Scripture's prohibition of necromancy and rendering religious honor to anyone but God (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Do not eat of a new crop until you have first offered a portion in the temple.
items.quote: Till they had offered a portion in the temple, they did not eat of a new crop.
items.conflict: Offering firstfruits to ancestors conflicts with giving thanks and worship to God alone, the giver of every harvest (Lev 23:10).

heading: Liji 15 · Shao Yi 少儀 · Smaller Rules Of Demeanour · Shao Yi 45 … Shao Yi 54

items.text: When carrying water, liquor, or food to a superior or elder, do not breathe on it; if asked a question, turn your head aside to answer.
items.quote: the rule was not to breathe on it; and if a question was asked, to turn the mouth on one side

items.text: When sending flesh of your own sacrifice to a superior man, simply announce what it is.
items.quote: When sending of the flesh of his own sacrifice to a superior man, the party simply announced what it was.

items.text: As principal mourner, spread out the sacrificial portions and send them with double bows, and bow again when your messenger returns.
items.quote: bowing twice, and laying his head to the ground... the mourner again bowed twice and laid his head to the ground
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

heading: Liji 15 · Shao Yi 少儀 · Smaller Rules Of Demeanour · Shao Yi 1 … Shao Yi 21

items.text: Do not presume to ask their age.
items.quote: he did not presume to ask their age

items.text: When they come to feast with you, do not send a formal message.
items.quote: he did not send to them any (formal) message

items.text: When meeting an elder on the road, go up to him if he sees you, but do not ask where he is going.
items.quote: he went up to them, but did not ask to know where they were going

items.text: At an elder's funeral, wait to observe the presiding mourner and do not offer special condolences.
items.quote: he waited to observe the movements (of the presiding mourner), and did not offer his special condolences

items.text: When seated by an elder, do not produce your lutes unless ordered to do so.
items.quote: he did not, unless ordered to do so, produce his lutes

items.text: When seated by an elder, do not draw lines on the ground.
items.quote: He did not draw lines on the ground

items.text: When seated by an elder, do not use a fan.
items.quote: He did not use a fan

items.text: If an elder is asleep and you have a message, kneel to deliver it.
items.quote: If they were asleep, and he had any message to communicate to them, he knelt in doing so
